article.title: Assessing a Digital Platform (KOKU-Nut) to Improve Nutrition in Older Adults: Mixed Methods Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial.
article.authors: French C, Burden S, Gangannagaripalli J
article.abstract: Keep-on-Keep-up Nutrition (KOKU-Nut) is a free, tablet-based digital platform that focuses on increasing physical activity and improving the dietary intake of older adults.
